field.$description: The field steps (rule 14): a text field, a select and a combobox sit a little into the surface they stand on. They are translucent, so the same steps read on a card, in a well and on the page, and the field never carries a line or a ring. Rest and hover are a faint wash of the theme's ink, focus lifts the field to its brightest, and a wrong value turns the wash red.

modes.name: nested
modes.$description: A well or a sub-card is a step lighter than the card in the dark and a step darker in the light, so its fields take a step more wash to stay apart from it.

field-invalid.$description: A wrong value, and the same while the field has the keys.

field-sink.$description: The faint shade under the field's top edge that sets it into the surface.
